jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Integration Manager (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  80-100% (Working from home up 40%) | Reference 8294

Do you want to work at the intersection of banking services, technology and customer integration? Are you motivated to help banks, partners and internal teams bring secure and stable services into production? Then our SIX BBS team wants to hear from you. We are responsible for onboarding, technical integration and operational support for services such as debiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit and bLink. In this role, you will work closely with banks, customers, software partners, vendors and internal teams across Product, IT, Security, Compliance and Operations. Your focus will be on technical integrations, customer onboarding, testing, go-live preparation, second-level support and a structured handover into regular operations. This is a central interface role between customers, technology and operations, rather than a pure project management, product owner or software engineering role.

What You Will Do

• Coordinate technical integration projects for debiX API and other BBS services such as eBill, Debit and ATM, from initial alignment through go-live and handover to operations.

• Act as the central contact for banks, customers, software partners, vendors, IT partners and internal teams during onboarding, testing, acceptance and production preparation.

• Clarify business, technical and operational requirements for API-based integrations, customer connections, certificates, environments and support processes.

• Support test preparation and execution, issue analysis, customer acceptance, go-live activities, hypercare and the transition into regular operations.

• Provide second-level support for customer requests, interface topics, certificates, integration issues and production-related incidents.

What You Bring

• Experience in technical customer integration, API integration, partner onboarding, service integration or technical project coordination, ideally in banking, payments or another regulated environment.

• Good understanding of REST APIs, XML, JSON, authentication, certificates, mutual TLS, OAuth or comparable security and interface topics.

• Experience with testing, acceptance, go-live preparation, incident handling, second-level support, service management and operational handover.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly to banks, customers, business teams, IT partners and vendors.

• Structured, pragmatic and reliable working style with a strong customer focus; fluent German and English, French or Italian is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Zurigo | 80-100% (Lavorare da casa fino al 40%) | Riferimento 8294

Vuoi lavorare all'intersezione dei servizi bancari, della tecnologia e dell'integrazione dei clienti? Sei motivato ad aiutare banche, partner e team interni a portare in produzione servizi sicuri e stabili? Allora il nostro team di SIX BBS vuole sentirti. Siamo responsabili dell'integrazione tecnica e del supporto operativo per servizi quali debiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit e bLink. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con banche, clienti, partner software, fornitori e team interni di prodotto, IT, sicurezza, conformità e operazioni. Il vostro focus sarà sulle integrazioni tecniche, l'accensione del cliente, il test, la preparazione del go-live, il supporto di secondo livello e una consegna strutturata in operazioni regolari. Questo è un ruolo di interfaccia centrale tra clienti, tecnologia e operazioni, piuttosto che un puro ruolo di gestione del progetto, proprietario del prodotto o ingegneria del software.

Cosa farai

• Coordinate i progetti di integrazione tecnica per debiX API e altri servizi BBS come eBill, Debit e ATM, dall'allineamento iniziale attraverso il go-live e il passaggio alle operazioni.

• Agire come contatto centrale per banche, clienti, partner software, fornitori, partner IT e team interni durante la preparazione di bordo, test, accettazione e produzione.

• Verificare i requisiti aziendali, tecnici e operativi per integrazioni basate su API, connessioni ai clienti, certificati, ambienti e processi di supporto.

• Preparazione e esecuzione del test di supporto, analisi dei problemi, accettazione del cliente, attività di go-live, ipercare e la transizione in operazioni regolari.

• Fornire supporto di secondo livello per le richieste dei clienti, argomenti di interfaccia, certificati, problemi di integrazione e incidenti legati alla produzione.

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza nell'integrazione tecnica dei clienti, integrazione API, integrazione dei partner, integrazione dei servizi o coordinamento tecnico dei progetti, idealmente nel settore bancario, dei pagamenti o di un altro ambiente regolamentato.

• Buona comprensione delle API REST, XML, JSON, autenticazione, certificati, TLS reciproci, OAuth o simili argomenti di sicurezza e interfaccia.

• Esperienza con test, accettazione, preparazione go-live, gestione degli incidenti, supporto di secondo livello, gestione dei servizi e consegna operativa.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e la capacità di spiegare chiaramente argomenti tecnici a banche, clienti, team aziendali, partner IT e fornitori.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, pragmatico e affidabile con un forte focus del cliente; fluente tedesco e inglese, francese o italiano è un vantaggio.

• Prepare high-quality presentations and materials for client meetings and internal discussions

• Conduct market analyses and research on IPOs, Equity Capital Markets, listed companies and relevant industry developments

• Support the preparation and execution of events, including IPO Workshops and the SIX IPO Academy

• Assist with the preparation of market intelligence, client materials and strategic analyses

• Contribute to ongoing initiatives aimed at strengthening SIX's position as an attractive listing venue

What You Bring

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business Administration, Banking & Finance or a related field

• Strong interest in Equity Capital Markets, IPOs and financial markets

• Ideally, prior experience in banking / equity capital markets

• Strong MS Office skills, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint. Experience working with Bloomberg, FactSet or Dealogic is a plus

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset & solid analytical, planning and organisational skills, with a high level of attention to detail

• Proactive mindset with a with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new topics.

• Native-level German and fluency in English are essential

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8392

SIX is establishing a group-wide AI Enablement Center to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence and translate AI opportunities into measurable business, customer and market outcomes.

The Head of AI Portfolio & Governance is responsible for establishing and managing the enterprise AI portfolio and governance capabilities across SIX.

What You Will Do

• Ensure that SIX has a reliable view of its AI initiatives, including ownership, lifecycle status, investment, expected and realised value, and governance status.

• Establish consistent governance from idea through production and retirement, with processes proportionate to risk.

• Establish portfolio reviews and senior management reporting on AI activities, investment, value and risk.

• Identify duplication, opportunities for reuse and common capabilities across the portfolio.

• Establish clear ownership, decision rights, escalation paths and documentation requirements for AI-related risks.

• Translate regulatory and policy developments into practical governance requirements, including risk classification, decision rights, approvals, escalation paths and documentation.

• Conduct AI governance assessments and coordinate reviews with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data Protection, Information Security and other control functions.

• This is a hands-on founding role. Initially establish and operate the portfolio and governance processes directly and gradually build the team as demand grows.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of practical experience in AI or technology portfolio management, AI governance, digital transformation, risk or a related field.

• Strong understanding of AI technologies, their business applications and associated risks.

• Experience establishing and operating portfolio management processes, governance frameworks or related functions in complex organisations.

• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including experience with business cases, investment tracking and value realisation.

• Strong understanding of risk management and regulated environments, with experience working across business, technology and control functions.

• Comfortable personally running workshops, assessing use cases, conducting governance reviews, preparing portfolio reporting and working with incomplete information.

• Experience setting up new teams and strong people management experience in international organizations, with the ability to establish processes and operating models from the ground up.

Zurigo | Fino al 40% lavorando da casa possibile | Riferimento 8392

SIX sta creando un AI Enablement Center a livello di gruppo per accelerare l'adozione di intelligenza artificiale e tradurre opportunità AI in risultati aziendali, clienti e di mercato misurabili.

Il Capo di AI Portfolio & Governance è responsabile della creazione e della gestione del portafoglio AI aziendale e delle capacità di governance in SIX.

Cosa farai

• Assicurarsi che SIX ha una visione affidabile delle sue iniziative AI, tra cui la proprietà, lo stato del ciclo di vita, gli investimenti, il valore atteso e realizzato e lo stato di governance.

• Condurre valutazioni di governance AI e coordinare le recensioni con Risk, Compliance, Legale, Protezione dei dati, Sicurezza delle informazioni e altre funzioni di controllo.

• Questo è un ruolo di base pratico. Inizialmente stabilire e gestire i processi di portafoglio e governance direttamente e gradualmente costruire il team come la domanda cresce.

• Esperienza di creazione e gestione del portafoglio operativo processi, quadri di governance o funzioni correlate in organizzazioni complesse.

• Forte giudizio commerciale e analitico, tra cui l'esperienza con i casi aziendali, il monitoraggio degli investimenti e la realizzazione del valore.

• Forte comprensione della gestione del rischio e degli ambienti regolamentati, con esperienza di lavoro nelle funzioni aziendali, tecnologiche e di controllo.

• Confortevole workshop di gestione personale, la valutazione dei casi di utilizzo, la conduzione di recensioni di governance, la preparazione di report di portafoglio e il lavoro con informazioni incomplete.

• Esperienza di creazione di nuovi team e forte esperienza di gestione delle persone nelle organizzazioni internazionali, con la capacità di stabilire processi e modelli operativi da zero.

Leiter AI Portfolio und Governance (100%)

Zürich | bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 8392

SIX richtet ein konzernweites AI Enablement Center ein, um die Einführung künstlicher Intelligenz zu beschleunigen und KI-Möglichkeiten in messbare Geschäfts-, Kunden- und Marktergebnisse umzusetzen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Sicherstellen, dass SIX einen zuverlässigen Überblick über ihre KI-Initiativen hat, einschließlich Eigentümerschaft, Lebenszyklusstatus, Investitionen, erwarteter und realisierter Wert und Governance-Status.

• Erstellung von Portfolio-Reviews und Berichterstattung der Geschäftsleitung über KI-Aktivitäten, Investitionen, Wert und Risiko.

• Identifizieren Sie Duplizierungen, Wiederverwendungsmöglichkeiten und gemeinsame Fähigkeiten im gesamten Portfolio.

• Etablieren Sie klare Eigentümer-, Entscheidungsrechte, Eskalationspfade und Dokumentationsanforderungen für KI-bezogene Risiken.

• Umsetzung regulatorischer und politischer Entwicklungen in praktische Governance-Anforderungen, einschließlich Risikoklassifizierung, Entscheidungsrechte, Genehmigungen, Eskalationspfade und Dokumentation.

• Führen Sie KI-Governance-Bewertungen durch und koordinieren Sie Überprüfungen mit Risiko-, Compliance-, Rechts-, Datenschutz-, Informationssicherheits- und anderen Kontrollfunktionen.

• Dies ist eine praktische Gründungsrolle. Aufbau und Betrieb der Portfolio- und Governance-Prozesse zunächst direkt und schrittweise Aufbau des Teams mit wachsender Nachfrage.

Was du mitbringst

• 7+ Jahre praktische Erfahrung in den Bereichen KI oder Technologieportfoliomanagement, KI-Governance, digitale Transformation, Risiko oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der KI-Technologien, ihrer Geschäftsanwendungen und der damit verbundenen Risiken.

• Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Portfoliomanagementprozessen, Governance-Frameworks oder verwandten Funktionen in komplexen Organisationen.

• Starkes kaufmännisches und analytisches Urteilsvermögen, einschließlich Erfahrung mit Geschäftsfällen, Anlageverfolgung und Wertrealisierung.

• Starkes Verständnis des Risikomanagements und regulierter Umgebungen mit Erfahrung in Geschäfts-, Technologie- und Kontrollfunktionen.

• Komfortable persönliche Durchführung von Workshops, Bewertung von Anwendungsfällen, Durchführung von Governance-Reviews, Erstellung von Portfolio-Reporting und Arbeit mit unvollständigen Informationen.

• Erfahrung in der Einrichtung neuer Teams und einer starken Erfahrung im Personalmanagement in internationalen Organisationen mit der Fähigkeit, Prozesse und Betriebsmodelle von Grund auf zu etablieren.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Responsable du portefeuille et de la gouvernance de l'IA (100%)

Zurich jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

SIX met en place un centre d'activation de l'IA à l'échelle du groupe afin d'accélérer l'adoption de l'intelligence artificielle et de traduire les possibilités d'IA en résultats mesurables pour les entreprises, les clients et le marché.

Le chef du portefeuille et de la gouvernance d'IA est chargé d'établir et de gérer le portefeuille et les capacités de gouvernance d'IA d'entreprise dans SIX.

Ce que vous ferez

• Veiller à ce que SIX ait une vision fiable de ses initiatives en matière d'IA, y compris la propriété, le statut de cycle de vie, l'investissement, la valeur attendue et réalisée, et le statut de gouvernance.

• Établir une gouvernance cohérente depuis l'idée jusqu'à la production et à la retraite, avec des processus proportionnels au risque.

• Établir des examens de portefeuille et des rapports de la haute direction sur les activités d'IA, les investissements, la valeur et le risque.

• Identifier les doubles emplois, les possibilités de réutilisation et les capacités communes dans l'ensemble du portefeuille.

• Établir des exigences claires en matière de propriété, de droits de décision, d'escalade et de documentation pour les risques liés à l'IA.

• Traduire l'évolution de la réglementation et des politiques en exigences pratiques de gouvernance, y compris la classification des risques, les droits de décision, les approbations, les voies d'escalade et la documentation.

• Effectuer des évaluations de la gouvernance de l'IA et coordonner les examens avec les fonctions de risque, de conformité, juridique, de protection des données, de sécurité de l'information et autres fonctions de contrôle.

• C'est un rôle fondateur pratique. Initialement, établir et gérer le portefeuille et les processus de gouvernance directement et progressivement construire l'équipe à mesure que la demande augmente.

Ce que vous apportez

• 7 ans et plus d'expérience pratique en gestion de portefeuille d'IA ou de technologie, gouvernance d'IA, transformation numérique, risque ou domaine connexe.

• Une bonne compréhension des technologies d'IA, de leurs applications commerciales et des risques associés.

• Expérience de l'établissement et de l'exploitation de processus de gestion de portefeuille, de cadres de gouvernance ou de fonctions connexes dans des organisations complexes.

• Fort jugement commercial et analytique, y compris l'expérience des analyses de rentabilisation, le suivi des investissements et la réalisation de valeurs.

• Une bonne compréhension de la gestion des risques et des environnements réglementés, avec une expérience de travail dans les fonctions d'affaires, de technologie et de contrôle.

• Des ateliers personnels confortables, l'évaluation des cas d'utilisation, l'examen de la gouvernance, la préparation de rapports de portefeuille et le travail avec des informations incomplètes.

• Expérience de la mise en place de nouvelles équipes et d'une solide expérience de la gestion des personnes dans les organisations internationales, avec la capacité d'établir des processus et des modèles opérationnels à partir de la base.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Zurich |  100% | Reference 8336

Would you like to gain valuable professional experience over a 12-month period while contributing to the Swiss financial center? Are you interested in combining strategic analysis with hands-on operational work? Then we would like to hear from you!

SIX Trade Repository, part of the Securities Services Business Unit, sits at the heart of derivatives reporting in the Swiss financial center. As a Strategy & Operations Intern, you will support the CEO on M&A, product and platform strategy, while working alongside the Head of Product and Operations and the Head of Client Support on day-to-day activities and improvement initiatives. This combination offers broad exposure to both the strategic development and operational delivery of financial market infrastructure services.

We offer opportunities to develop your skills at the intersection of technology and finance. You will gain experience through cross-functional collaboration and practical responsibilities, while becoming part of our NextGen Community, a network of engaged career starters.

What You Will Do

• support the CEO on strategic initiatives and M&A activities through research, analysis and the preparation of decision-making materials

• contribute to the development and implementation of SIX Trade Repository’s product and platform strategy

• prepare market and competitor analyses, business cases and management presentations in collaboration with Business, Strategy/M&A and IT teams

• support the Head of Product and Operations and the Head of Client Support in day-to-day activities and cross-functional projects

• assist with client onboarding and technical coordination, and help address business and technical queries together with the relevant specialists

• contribute to initiatives aimed at improving operational quality, efficiency and the overall client experience

• take on additional responsibilities based on your interests, strengths and development goals

What You Bring

• university degree in economics, finance, management or a related field; an engineering background combined with a strong interest in finance is also welcome

• initial professional experience in banking, asset management, management consulting or a related environment is an advantage

• strong analytical skills combined with a structured and solution-oriented way of working

• ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across different teams and stakeholder groups

• excellent written and spoken English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: Senior PAM & Secrets Management Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior PAM & Secrets Management Engineer

Zurich |  Working from home 40% possible | Reference 8314

Are you passionate about Privileged Access Management, secrets management, and Identity Security? Join us as a Senior PAM & Secrets Management Engineer and help design secure, scalable access solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. Working with Delinea Secret Server and OpenBao, you will protect privileged accounts, secrets, service accounts, APIs, and machine identities while contributing to our Identity Security strategy.

What You Will Do

• Build, configure, and operate modern PAM and secrets management platforms, including Delinea Secret Server and OpenBao.

• Connect PAM and secrets management solutions with technologies such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud platforms, DevOps pipelines, SIEM, ITSM, and enterprise applications.

• Improve onboarding, automation, credential rotation, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operations for privileged accounts and secrets.

• Explore how AI, automation, autonomous agents, and non-human identities are changing IAM, PAM, and Identity Security.

• Contribute ideas, challenge existing approaches, and help build the next generation of secure and efficient PAM capabilities.

What You Bring

• 6+ year hands-on experience with PAM tools, including platform engineering, operations, integrations, and secure lifecycle management.

• Good understanding of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, and hybrid infrastructure environments.

• A solid understanding of privileged access management, secrets management, machine and non-human identities, Zero Trust principles, and emerging AI security topics.

• The ability to look beyond individual tools and design pragmatic solutions that balance security, usability, operations, and regulatory expectations.

• A collaborative mindset and the confidence to act as a trusted advisor for business, technology, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Lavorando con Delinea Secret Server e OpenBao, proteggerai account privilegiati, segreti, account di servizio, API e identità di macchina, contribuendo alla nostra strategia di sicurezza di identità.

Cosa farai

• Costruire, configurare e utilizzare moderne piattaforme di gestione PAM e segreti, tra cui Delinea Secret Server e OpenBao.

• Collegare PAM e soluzioni di gestione dei segreti con tecnologie come Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, piattaforme cloud, pipeline DevOps, SIEM, ITSM e applicazioni enterprise.

• Migliorare l'accensione, l'automazione, la rotazione delle credenziali, la gestione del ciclo di vita e le operazioni quotidiane per conti e segreti privilegiati.

• Scopri come l'IA, l'automazione, gli agenti autonomi e le identità non umane stanno cambiando IAM, PAM e Identity Security.

• Contribuisci idee, sfida gli approcci esistenti e aiuta a costruire la prossima generazione di funzionalità PAM sicure ed efficienti.

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza pratica di 6+ anni con strumenti PAM, tra cui ingegneria piattaforma, operazioni, integrazioni e gestione sicura del ciclo di vita.

• Buona comprensione di Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows, Linux, piattaforme cloud e ambienti di infrastrutture ibride.

• Una solida comprensione della gestione privilegiata dell'accesso, della gestione dei segreti, della macchina e delle identità non umane, dei principi della Zero Trust e degli argomenti emergenti della sicurezza dell'AI.

• La capacità di guardare oltre i singoli strumenti e di progettare soluzioni pragmatiche che bilanciano la sicurezza, l'usabilità, le operazioni e le aspettative normative.

• Una mentalità collaborativa e la fiducia di agire come consulente di fiducia per gli stakeholder di business, tecnologia, rischio e conformità.

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Product Manager - International Custody (80-100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8382

Shape the future of international custody and value-added services as a Senior Product Manager within Securities Services. In this strategic role, you will own the product vision, roadmap, lifecycle and commercial direction of the international custody portfolio, translating client and market needs into scalable, competitive and economically sustainable propositions. Working closely with Product Development, PM Solutions, Sales, Operations, Technology and other specialist functions, you will strengthen the core custody offering and develop integrated services across settlement, market access, collateral, liquidity, FX, securities lending, tax and analytics.

Does it sound interesting for you? Don't hesitate and apply with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Own the strategy, target proposition and rolling roadmap for international custody, settlement and adjacent post-trade services.

• Develop client-focused propositions and translate market, regulatory and commercial demand into clear product requirements, priorities and success criteria.

• Assess and prioritize value-added opportunities across market access, auto-credit, collateral, cash, FX, securities lending, tax, analytics, ETF and selected BPO services.

• Build business cases, pricing and lifecycle recommendations, and monitor revenue, profitability, adoption, assets under custody, cost-to-serve and retention.

• Lead product governance and cross-functional alignment, supporting strategic client discussions and ensuring clear handoffs to Solutioning, Delivery, Technology and Operations.

What You Bring

• At least 7 years of experience in product management, securities services, financial-market infrastructure, transaction banking, consulting or a comparable field.

• In-depth knowledge of international custody, post-trade services, settlement and market-access models.

• Proven ability to size opportunities, define value propositions, build business cases and shape pricing, portfolio and lifecycle recommendations.

• Strong client orientation and financial acumen, combined with excellent analytical, negotiation, stakeholder-management and executive communication skills.

• Fluent English; German is strongly preferred, while Spanish or other languages are an advantage. Exposure to cash, FX, collateral, securities lending, tax, execution, analytics or BPO services is beneficial.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Formare il futuro della custodia internazionale e dei servizi a valore aggiunto come Senior Product Manager all'interno di Securities Services. In questo ruolo strategico, possederai la visione del prodotto, la roadmap, il ciclo di vita e la direzione commerciale del portafoglio di custodia internazionale, traducendo le esigenze del cliente e del mercato in proposte scalabili, competitive ed economicamente sostenibili. • Sviluppare proposte orientate al cliente e tradurre la domanda di mercato, normativa e commerciale in requisiti di prodotto chiari, priorità e criteri di successo.

• Valutare e dare priorità alle opportunità di valore aggiunto attraverso l'accesso al mercato, l'autocredito, la garanzia, il denaro, FX, il prestito di titoli, fiscale, analisi, ETF e servizi BPO selezionati.

• Costruire i casi aziendali, i prezzi e le raccomandazioni del ciclo di vita, e monitorare i ricavi, la redditività, l'adozione, i beni sotto la custodia, il costo per il servizio e la ritenzione.

• Conoscenza approfondita della custodia internazionale, dei servizi post-commerciali, dei modelli di insediamento e accesso al mercato.

• Prova capacità di dimensionare le opportunità, definire le proposizioni di valore, costruire i casi di business e modellare i prezzi, portafoglio e raccomandazioni del ciclo di vita.

• Forte orientamento del cliente e acume finanziario, combinato con eccellenti capacità di comunicazione analitica, di negoziazione, di gestione degli stakeholder e executive.

• Inglese fluente; tedesco è fortemente preferito, mentre spagnolo o altre lingue sono un vantaggio. L'esposizione a cash, FX, collaterale, titoli di prestito, fiscale, esecuzione, analisi o servizi BPO è utile.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Senior Product Manager - International Custody (80-100%)

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8382

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der internationalen Verwahrung und Mehrwertdienste als Senior Product Manager bei Securities Services. In dieser strategischen Rolle werden Sie die Produktvision, die Roadmap, den Lebenszyklus und die kommerzielle Ausrichtung des internationalen Depotportfolios besitzen und Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse in skalierbare, wettbewerbsfähige und wirtschaftlich nachhaltige Vorschläge übersetzen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Development, PM Solutions, Sales, Operations, Technology und anderen Spezialfunktionen stärken Sie das zentrale Depotangebot und entwickeln integrierte Dienstleistungen für Abwicklung, Marktzugang, Sicherheiten, Liquidität, FX, Wertpapierleihe, Steuern und Analysen.

Klingt das für dich interessant? Zögern Sie nicht und bewerben Sie sich mit Ihrem Lebenslauf auf Englisch.

Was Sie tun werden

• Eigene Strategie, Zielvorstellung und Rolling Roadmap für internationale Verwahrung, Abwicklung und angrenzende Post-Trade-Dienstleistungen.

• Kundenorientierte Vorschläge entwickeln und Markt-, regulatorische und kommerzielle Nachfrage in klare Produktanforderungen, Prioritäten und Erfolgskriterien übersetzen.

• Bewerten und priorisieren Sie Mehrwertmöglichkeiten für den Marktzugang, Autokredite, Sicherheiten, Bargeld, FX, Wertpapierleihe, Steuern, Analysen, ETF und ausgewählte BPO-Dienste.

• Erstellen Sie Business Cases, Preis- und Lifecycle-Empfehlungen und überwachen Sie Umsatz, Rentabilität, Adoption, Assets under Custody, Cost-to-Service und Retention.

• Führen Sie Produkt-Governance und funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung, unterstützen Sie strategische Kundengespräche und sorgen Sie für klare Übergaben an Solutioning, Delivery, Technology und Operations.

Was du mitbringst

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Wertpapierdienstleistungen, Finanzmarktinfrastruktur, Transaction Banking, Consulting oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.

• Tiefes Wissen über internationale Verwahrung, Nachhandelsdienstleistungen, Abwicklung und Marktzugangsmodelle.

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, Chancen zu bewerten, Wertversprechen zu definieren, Business Cases zu erstellen und Preis-, Portfolio- und Lifecycle-Empfehlungen zu gestalten.

• Starke Kundenorientierung und finanzieller Scharfsinn, kombiniert mit exzellenten analytischen, Verhandlungs-, Stakeholder-Management- und Executive-Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Fließend Englisch; Deutsch wird stark bevorzugt, während Spanisch oder andere Sprachen von Vorteil sind. Die Exposition gegenüber Bargeld, FX, Sicherheiten, Wertpapierleihen, Steuern, Ausführung, Analysen oder BPO-Dienstleistungen ist von Vorteil.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an.

Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Gestionnaire principal de produits - International Custody (80-100%)

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8382

Façonner l'avenir des services internationaux de garde et de valeur ajoutée en tant que gestionnaire principal de produits au sein des Services de valeurs mobilières. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous posséderez la vision du produit, la feuille de route, le cycle de vie et l'orientation commerciale du portefeuille de la garde internationale, traduisant les besoins du client et du marché en propositions évolutives, compétitives et économiquement durables. En étroite collaboration avec Développement de produits, Solutions PM, Ventes, Opérations, Technologie et d'autres fonctions spécialisées, vous renforcerez l'offre de garde de base et développerez des services intégrés à travers le règlement, l'accès au marché, les garanties, la liquidité, FX, les prêts de titres, la fiscalité et l'analyse.

Ça te semble intéressant ? N'hésitez pas et appliquez avec votre CV en anglais.

Ce que vous ferez

• Posséder la stratégie, la proposition cible et la feuille de route pour la garde internationale, le règlement et les services post-négociations adjacents.

• Élaborer des propositions axées sur les clients et traduire la demande commerciale, réglementaire et commerciale en exigences, priorités et critères de réussite clairs.

• Évaluer et classer par ordre de priorité les possibilités de valeur ajoutée dans les domaines suivants : accès aux marchés, crédit automatique, garanties, espèces, prêts sur titres, impôts, analyses, ETF et certains services de BPO.

• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation, des recommandations sur les prix et le cycle de vie, et surveiller les revenus, la rentabilité, l'adoption, les biens sous garde, le coût à payer et la conservation.

• Diriger la gouvernance des produits et l'harmonisation interfonctionnelle, appuyer les discussions stratégiques avec les clients et assurer un transfert clair à la solution, à la prestation, à la technologie et aux opérations.

Ce que vous apportez

• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits, les services de valeurs mobilières, l'infrastructure du marché financier, les opérations bancaires, les consultations ou un domaine comparable.

• Connaissance approfondie de la garde internationale, des services après-vente, des modèles de règlement et d'accès au marché.

• Capacité éprouvée de tailler les occasions, de définir des propositions de valeur, de construire des analyses de rentabilisation et de façonner les prix, le portefeuille et les recommandations du cycle de vie.

• Forte orientation des clients et acuité financière, combinée à d'excellentes compétences en analyse, en négociation, en gestion des intervenants et en communication avec les cadres supérieurs.

• Anglais fluent; l'allemand est fortement préféré, tandis que l'espagnol ou d'autres langues sont un avantage. L'exposition à l'argent comptant, aux FX, aux garanties, aux prêts de titres, à l'impôt, à l'exécution, à l'analyse ou aux services BPO est bénéfique.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 .

Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons seulement les candidatures directes en anglais.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: AI Software Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Software Architect

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8259

Shape and execute the AI SDLC at SIX · reports to Head of Software Engineering Practices

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. As AI Software Architect, you will set the technical direction for this shift: designing the reference patterns, tooling, and quality gates that make AI-augmented and agentic development safe and effective in a regulated financial market infrastructure, and driving adoption across teams you don't manage.

What You Will Do

• Translate the AI software engineering strategy into working practice. Design, prototype and harden the reference patterns, tooling and reusable components that make AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) real across SIX.

• Set the deepest technical standards for AI-based development: prompt and agent patterns, code review of AI-generated code, and the quality and security gates that make it safe in a regulated FMI.

• Support and execute the people transformation journey, evolving developer roles, team structures, processes and ways of working to unlock the full potential of AI-augmented software engineering

• Run lighthouse engagements hands-on: understand the process of business-unit software teams, baseline and measure impact on real backlogs, and prove value before scaling.

• Drive adoption across teams you don't manage. Coach senior engineers, win over skeptics, and lead the community of practice across CH, ES, PL and IN.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in software engineering with deep with current hands-on expertise across the entire SDLC. You still design software systems, write and review code, and engineers trust your technical judgment.

• Strong systems and architecture thinking across the end-to-end SDLC, and sound judgment on putting AI into a regulated, business-critical environment

• Hands-on experience with AI harness, LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including building custom workflows when off-the-shelf falls short. Claude Code hands-on experience in production is a plus.

• A track record of driving change through influence, not authority. You've won over skeptical senior engineers and spread practice across teams you didn't manage.

• Excellent stakeholder management, low ego and a teaching instinct — equally credible in a design review with a principal engineer and a risk conversation with security; fluent in English, German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

AI Software Architetto

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8259

Formare ed eseguire il SDLC AI a SIX · rapporti a capo delle pratiche di ingegneria del software

Agentic AI sta cambiando come il software viene costruito — e a SIX, toccherà il lavoro di più di mille ingegneri. Come AI Software Architect, si imposta la direzione tecnica per questo cambiamento: progettare i modelli di riferimento, strumenti e cancelli di qualità che rendono lo sviluppo AI-augmented e agentic sicuro ed efficace in un'infrastruttura di mercato finanziario regolamentata, e guidare l'adozione in team che non gestisci.

Cosa farai

• Traduci la strategia di ingegneria del software AI nella pratica di lavoro. Progettazione, prototipo e indurimento dei modelli di riferimento, utensili e componenti riutilizzabili che rendono AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) reale attraverso SIX.

• Impostare gli standard tecnici più profondi per lo sviluppo basato su AI: modelli di prompt e agente, la revisione del codice del codice generato dall'IA, e le porte di qualità e sicurezza che lo rendono sicuro in un FMI regolamentato.

• Sostenere ed eseguire il viaggio di trasformazione delle persone, l'evoluzione dei ruoli dello sviluppatore, le strutture del team, i processi e i modi di lavorare per sbloccare il pieno potenziale dell'ingegneria del software aumentata dall'IA

• Eseguire gli impegni del faro hands-on: capire il processo di business-unit software team, baseline e misura l'impatto su backlog reali, e dimostrare il valore prima di scaling.

• Guida l'adozione tra le squadre che non gestisci. Allenatori senior, vincere gli scettici, e guidare la comunità di pratica attraverso CH, ES, PL e IN.

Che cosa porta

• 8+ anni di ingegneria del software con profonda esperienza pratica in tutto il SDLC. Si progetta ancora sistemi software, scrivere e rivedere il codice, e gli ingegneri si fidano del vostro giudizio tecnico.

• Sistemi e architettura forti che pensano attraverso il SDLC end-to-end, e giudizio sonoro sul mettere l'IA in un ambiente regolamentato, business-critical

• Hands-on esperienza con imbracatura AI, API LLM e quadri di agente, tra cui la costruzione di flussi di lavoro personalizzati quando fuori-the-shelf cade breve. Claude Code esperienza pratica nella produzione è un vantaggio.

• Una traccia di cambiamento di guida attraverso l'influenza, non l'autorità. Hai vinto gli ingegneri senior scettici e la pratica di diffusione in squadre che non hai gestito.

• Eccellente gestione degli stakeholder, basso ego e un istinto di insegnamento — altrettanto credibile in una recensione di progettazione con un ingegnere principale e una conversazione di rischio con la sicurezza; fluente in inglese, tedesco un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Gestalten und Ausführen des AI SDLC bei SIX · Berichte an Head of Software Engineering Practices

Agentic AI verändert die Art und Weise, wie Software gebaut wird - und bei SIX wird es die Arbeit von mehr als tausend Ingenieuren berühren. Als KI-Software-Architekt legen Sie die technische Richtung für diesen Wandel fest: Entwerfen der Referenzmuster, Tools und Qualitätsgates, die die KI-gestützte und agentische Entwicklung in einer regulierten Finanzmarktinfrastruktur sicher und effektiv machen, und die Einführung in Teams, die Sie nicht verwalten.

Was Sie tun werden

• Übersetzen Sie die KI-Software-Engineering-Strategie in die Praxis. Entwerfen, Prototypen und Härten der Referenzmuster, Werkzeuge und wiederverwendbaren Komponenten, die AI SDLC (erweitert, agentisch) in SIX real machen.

• Setzen Sie die tiefsten technischen Standards für die KI-basierte Entwicklung: Aufforderungs- und Agentenmuster, Code-Review von KI-generiertem Code und die Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsgates, die ihn in einem regulierten FMI sicher machen.

• Unterstützung und Umsetzung der Transformationsreise der Menschen, sich entwickelnde Entwicklerrollen, Teamstrukturen, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen, um das volle Potenzial des KI-erweiterten Software-Engineerings zu erschließen

• Führen Sie Lighthouse-Engagements praktisch durch: Verstehen Sie den Prozess von Business-Unit-Softwareteams, berechnen und messen Sie die Auswirkungen auf echte Backlogs und beweisen Sie den Wert vor der Skalierung.

• Steigern Sie die Adoption in Teams, die Sie nicht verwalten. Coach leitende Ingenieure, gewinnen Skeptiker und führen die Gemeinschaft der Praxis in CH, ES, PL und IN.

Was du mitbringst

• 8+ Jahre in Software Engineering mit tief mit aktuellen Hands-on-Know-how in der gesamten SDLC. Sie entwerfen immer noch Softwaresysteme, schreiben und überprüfen Code, und Ingenieure vertrauen Ihrem technischen Urteilsvermögen.

• Starkes System- und Architekturdenken im gesamten End-to-End-SDLC und fundiertes Urteil darüber, KI in ein reguliertes, geschäftskritisches Umfeld zu versetzen

• Hands-on-Erfahrung mit KI-Geschirr, LLM-APIs und Agent-Frameworks, einschließlich der Erstellung benutzerdefinierter Workflows, wenn der Standard zu kurz kommt. Claude Code praktische Erfahrung in der Produktion ist ein Plus.

• Eine Erfolgsbilanz der treibenden Veränderung durch Einfluss, nicht Autorität. Sie haben skeptische leitende Ingenieure gewonnen und die Praxis in Teams verbreitet, die Sie nicht verwaltet haben.

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management, niedriges Ego und ein Lehrinstinkt – ebenso glaubwürdig in einer Design-Review mit einem leitenden Ingenieur und einem Risikogespräch mit Sicherheit; fließend Englisch, Deutsch ein Plus.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Architecte logiciel AI

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Former et exécuter le SDLC AI à SIX · rapports au responsable des pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle

L'IA agentique change la façon dont le logiciel se construit — et chez SIX, elle touchera le travail de plus de mille ingénieurs. En tant qu'architecte logiciel de l'IA, vous définirez la direction technique de ce changement : concevoir les modèles de référence, l'outillage et les barrières de qualité qui rendent le développement de l'IA sécuritaire et efficace dans une infrastructure de marché financier réglementée, et conduire l'adoption à travers les équipes que vous ne gérez pas.

Ce que vous ferez

• Traduire la stratégie d'ingénierie logicielle en pratique de travail. Concevoir, prototyper et durcir les modèles de référence, l'outillage et les composants réutilisables qui rendent AI SDLC (augmenté, agentique) réel sur SIX.

• Définir les normes techniques les plus profondes pour le développement basé sur l'IA : modèles d'agents rapides, révision de code du code généré par l'IA, et les barrières de qualité et de sécurité qui le rendent sûr dans un FMI réglementé.

• Soutenir et exécuter le parcours de transformation des personnes, l'évolution des rôles de développeur, les structures d'équipe, les processus et les façons de travailler pour libérer tout le potentiel de l'ingénierie logicielle augmentée par l'IA

• Exécuter des engagements de phare : comprendre le processus des équipes de logiciels de l'unité d'affaires, mesurer l'impact sur les arriérés réels et prouver la valeur avant l'échelle.

• Conduisez l'adoption à travers les équipes que vous ne gérez pas. Coach ingénieurs seniors, gagner les sceptiques, et diriger la communauté de pratique à travers CH, ES, PL et IN.

Ce que vous apportez

• 8+ ans en ingénierie logicielle avec une expertise pratique actuelle dans tout le SDLC. Vous concevez encore des systèmes logiciels, écrivez et revoyez le code, et les ingénieurs font confiance à votre jugement technique.

• Des systèmes et une architecture solides dans l'ensemble du SDLC de bout en bout, et un bon jugement sur la mise en place de l'IA dans un environnement réglementé et critique pour les entreprises

• Expérience pratique avec le harnais d'IA, les API LLM et les cadres d'agents, y compris la construction de workflows personnalisés lorsque hors de la plate-forme tombe à court. Claude Code expérience pratique dans la production est un plus.

• Une expérience de la conduite du changement par l'influence, pas l'autorité. Vous avez gagné sur les ingénieurs seniors sceptiques et réparti la pratique entre les équipes que vous n'avez pas gérées.

• Excellente gestion des parties prenantes, faible ego et un instinct d'enseignement — également crédible dans une revue de conception avec un ingénieur principal et une conversation de risque avec la sécurité; couramment en anglais, allemand un plus.

jobs.title: (Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

(Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80-100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8269

Would you like to shape the future of IAM across workforce identities, cloud services and AI agents? As a Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer, you are an IAM specialist who understands SailPoint IdentityIQ well enough to shape feasible concepts and challenge technical options, while owning stakeholder alignment, requirements and processes. You bring together business, governance, data and technology perspectives, communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and use data to support sound decisions. Working closely with IAM engineers, QA, operations, application owners, risk and audit, you turn emerging needs into sustainable processes and solutions. Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust guide how we work together and deliver value.

What You Will Do

• Translate business, risk and regulatory needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements, process models, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Shape and evolve IAM capabilities and governance models across workforce IAM, cloud services, non-human identities including AI agents as well as policy-based access control (PBAC), translating emerging needs into scalable processes and feasible solution concepts.

• Develop solution designs for SailPoint IdentityIQ by assessing platform capabilities, defining workflows and data flows, and aligning concepts with IAM engineers and architects.

• Analyze IAM data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps and automation opportunities, and present evidence-based recommendations.

• Act as the bridge between stakeholders and the distributed delivery team, supporting prioritisation, implementation, testing, rollout and adoption of sustainable IAM solutions.

What You Bring

• Several years of experience as an IAM Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer or Consultant in IAM, with strong knowledge of IAM and IGA, access governance, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, role engineering, certifications, Segregation of Duties and relevant control requirements; experience with IAM aspects of cloud services or AI agents is an advantage.

• Practical knowledge of SailPoint IIQ/ISC and a sound understanding of systems and application architecture, including how corporate systems work together.

• Proven experience in requirements engineering, process modelling and the software development lifecycle, with sufficient technical literacy to assess feasibility, understand implementation approaches and constructively challenge technical proposals.

• Strong analytical and data skills, including SQL and BI tools (Python is an advantage), with the ability to turn complex information into sound decisions and clear recommendations.

• Confident communication and facilitation skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders in English; German is an advantage, combined with customer focus, ownership and attention to detail.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Within SIX Exchange Regulation, the Surveillance Assurance & Development team is responsible for the continuous enhancement of surveillance capabilities, data quality and the evolution of surveillance systems and methodologies.
As a Regulatory Data Analyst, you will act as the subject matter expert for Transaction Reporting under MiFID II (RTS 22) and Swiss FMIA requirements and help ensure that Transaction Reporting data is complete, accurate and fit for surveillance, compliance and enforcement purposes. You will work closely with Surveillance, Enforcement & Compliance and IT teams and contribute to the ongoing development of surveillance capabilities and data quality.

• Conduct analyses based on transaction reporting data and provide expert support to surveillance, compliance and enforcement activities, including investigations, requests from regulatory and supervisory authorities, and reporting-related assessments.

• Provide Transaction Reporting expertise and contribute to surveillance initiatives, regulatory changes, system enhancements and continuous improvement of transaction reporting data quality in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders.

What You Bring

• University degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Experience in finance, capital markets or stock exchange environments. Good understanding of trading activities and financial instruments (e.g. equities, bonds, ETFs, warrants and derivatives). Experience in regulatory transaction reporting is a strong advantage.

• Strong analytical mindset and good SQL and Python knowledge with the ability to analyze, investigate and validate large datasets. Experience with Databricks and PySpark is an advantage.

• High attention to detail, proactive working style and strong communication skills.

• Fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Cyber Security

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8420

Are you ready to shape cyber security at one of Europe’s key financial market infrastructure providers? As Department Head Cyber Security, you will set the direction for a diverse, international organisation and create an environment where people can perform at their best. You will bring clarity to complex challenges, strengthen trust across the organisation and support informed decision-making in a highly regulated environment. This is a senior leadership opportunity for someone who combines sound judgement, strong communication and a collaborative mindset. Your leadership will help SIX remain resilient, trusted and prepared for an evolving cyber threat landscape.

What You Will Do

• Lead the Cyber Security Department end to end, covering strategy, people, technology, 24x7 operations, service performance, budgets and continuous improvement across all locations.

• Define the Cyber Security operating model, governance, service strategy and priorities in line with the Group strategy, risk appetite, client commitments and critical-infrastructure responsibilities.

• Own cyber defence and major-incident readiness across security operations, threat detection, incident response, crisis management, threat intelligence, threat hunting and detection engineering.

• Drive cyber platform engineering and resilience, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability management, secure configuration, automation, telemetry, analytics and responsible use of AI.

• Ensure regulatory alignment, transparent performance reporting and effective stakeholder management across ISF, NIST CSF 2.0, NIS2, ISO 27001, DORA, FINMA, CNMV, audits, suppliers and the India BOT transition.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of progressive Cyber Security experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role with significant people, service and operational responsibility.

• Proven leadership of global or multi-country 24x7 cyber operations, including high-severity incidents, crisis decisions and communication with executives, clients and regulators.

• Strong experience in financial services, financial market infrastructure or critical infrastructure, with deep knowledge of SOC, incident response, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, SIEM, SOAR, EDR and automation.

• Practical knowledge of ISF, NIS2, NIST CSF 2.0, ISO 27001, DORA, FINMA, CNMV, operational resilience and third-party risk, combined with strong strategic, commercial and financial judgement.

• A university degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Information Systems, Business IT or a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CRISC are an advantage.

• Outstanding leadership, stakeholder communication skills and fluent in English; German, Spanish or Polish are advantages.

• Veiller à l'harmonisation réglementaire, à la transparence des rapports sur le rendement et à une gestion efficace des intervenants dans l'ensemble du FSI, du CSF 2.0 du NIST, du NIS2, de l'ISO 27001, du DORA, de la FINMA, du CNMV, des audits, des fournisseurs et de la transition du BOT en Inde.

Ce que vous apportez

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en cybersécurité progressive, dont au moins 5 ans dans un rôle de leadership avec des personnes importantes, des services et des responsabilités opérationnelles.

• Leadership éprouvé des cyberopérations mondiales ou multipays 24x7, y compris les incidents de grande gravité, les décisions de crise et la communication avec les cadres, les clients et les organismes de réglementation.

• Forte expérience des services financiers, de l'infrastructure des marchés financiers ou de l'infrastructure critique, avec une connaissance approfondie de la SOC, de l'intervention en cas d'incident, du renseignement sur les menaces, de la gestion de la vulnérabilité, du SIEM, de la SOAR, de l'EDR et de l'automatisation.

• Connaissance pratique du FSI, du NIS2, du NIST CSF 2.0, de l'ISO 27001, de la DORA, de la FINMA, du CNMV, de la résilience opérationnelle et du risque de tiers, associée à un jugement stratégique, commercial et financier fort.

• Diplôme universitaire en informatique, sécurité de l'information, génie, systèmes d'information, informatique d'affaires ou un domaine comparable, ou expérience professionnelle équivalente. Les certifications pertinentes comme le CISSP, le CISM ou le CRISC sont un avantage.

• Un leadership exceptionnel, des compétences en communication avec les intervenants et une maîtrise de l'anglais; l'allemand, l'espagnol ou le polonais sont des avantages.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Piombo di misurazione e di insights CMC

Zurich | Lavorare da casa 40% | Riferimento 8338

Il CMC Measurement & Insights Lead possiede il quadro di misura unificato e il programma ROMI. Come unica fonte di verità, il ruolo trasforma l'analisi in decisioni di bilancio e di investimento. • Traduci attribuzione, mix di marketing e intuizioni di incremento nelle raccomandazioni di bilancio e adozione più forte.

Che cosa porta

• Esperienza comprovata nella misura di marketing, nella gestione delle prestazioni o in ROMI, ideale in B2B o nei servizi finanziari.

• Forte competenza nell'attribuzione, analisi di marketing e attivazione commerciale, trasformando i modelli in campagne eseguibili.

• Capacità di stabilire la credibilità finanziaria attraverso la convalida, la riconciliazione e l'auditability.

• Forte gestione senior-stakeholder, facilitazione interfunzionale e competenze di guida partner.

• Fluenza con BI e prodotti di dati moderni, oltre all'esperienza con processi abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale e alla gestione dei cambiamenti.

CMC Measurement & Insights Lead

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause 40% | Referenz 8338

SIX baut eine dedizierte Tech & Data-Fähigkeit innerhalb von Marketing & Communications (CMC) auf. Ziel ist es, Marketing Insights-geführt, automatisiert und messbar zu machen. Der CMC Measurement & Insights Lead ist Eigentümer des einheitlichen Messrahmens und des ROMI-Programms. Als einzige Quelle der Wahrheit verwandelt die Rolle die Analyse in Budget- und Investitionsentscheidungen. Erfolg erfordert analytische Strenge, Glaubwürdigkeit im Finanzwesen und eine starke Ausrichtung der Stakeholder.

• Führen Sie das ROMI-Programm, vom MVP-Umfang und der Partnerlieferung bis zur Annahme und Übergabe.

• Bauen und verwalten Sie das ROMI-Cockpit mit zertifizierten Datenprodukten für Führungskräfte, Finanzen und Geschäftseinheiten.

• Leiten Sie die Mess-Governance und stimmen Sie Marketing, Vertrieb und Finanzen auf gemeinsame Definitionen ab.

• Übersetzen Sie Attribution, Marketing-Mix und Inkrementalität in Budgetempfehlungen und stärkere Akzeptanz.

Was du mitbringst

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Marketing-Messung, Performance Management oder ROMI, idealerweise in B2B oder Finanzdienstleistungen.

• Starke Expertise in den Bereichen Attribution, Marketing Analytics und kommerzielle Aktivierung, die Modelle in ausführbare Kampagnen verwandeln.

• Fähigkeit, Glaubwürdigkeit im Finanzwesen durch Validierung, Abgleich und Auditierbarkeit herzustellen.

• Starkes Senior-Stakeholder-Management, funktionsübergreifende Facilitation und Partner-Lenkfähigkeiten.

• Fließend mit BI und modernen Datenprodukten sowie Erfahrung mit KI-fähigen Prozessen und Change Management.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Mesure et analyse du CMC

Zurich: Travail à domicile: 40%Référence 8338

SIX met en place une capacité technique et de données au sein du marketing et des communications (CMC). L'objectif est de rendre le marketing éclairé, automatisé et mesurable. Le CMC Measurement & Insights Lead possède le cadre de mesure unifié et le programme ROMI. Comme source unique de vérité, le rôle transforme l'analyse en décisions de budget et d'investissement. La réussite exige une rigueur analytique, une crédibilité financière et une forte harmonisation des intervenants.

Ce que vous ferez

• Posséder le cadre de mesure unifié, y compris les KPI, les entonnoirs, les définitions du cycle de vie et la validation des finances.

• Diriger le programme ROMI, du champ d'application du MVP et de la livraison des partenaires à l'acceptation et au transfert.

• Construisez et gérez le cockpit ROMI en utilisant des produits de données certifiés pour les cadres, les finances et les unités d'affaires.

• Diriger la gouvernance de la mesure et aligner le marketing, les ventes et les finances sur les définitions partagées.

• Traduire l'attribution, la combinaison de marketing et les aperçus d'accroissement dans les recommandations budgétaires et une adoption plus forte.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience éprouvée en mesure marketing, gestion du rendement ou ROMI, idéalement en B2B ou services financiers.

• Forte expertise en attribution, en marketing analytique et en activation commerciale, transformant les modèles en campagnes exécutables.

• Capacité d'établir la crédibilité des Finances par la validation, le rapprochement et la vérification.

• Forte gestion des intervenants, facilitation interfonctionnelle et compétences de pilotage des partenaires.

• La fluidité avec le BI et les produits de données modernes, ainsi que l'expérience avec les processus compatibles avec l'IA et la gestion du changement.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Julia Schmidt au +41583998670 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.
